persona.name: Trang Nguyen

occupation.title: Data Engineer
occupation.description: Trang develops and maintains data pipelines and tools for logistics operations. She collaborates regularly with data scientists and developers to ensure accurate, reliable data flows and supports troubleshooting analytics infrastructure.

persona.education: Earned a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology, and completed a professional certificate in Data Engineering after moving to Singapore.

openness.description: She enjoys trying different methods to solve technical problems.

conscientiousness.description: Trang reliably follows through on assignments and double-checks her work.

extraversion.description: She’s friendly but prefers listening over holding the floor.

agreeableness.description: Trang tends to go along with group consensus and is rarely confrontational.

neuroticism.description: She sometimes feels nervous in high-stakes presentations but manages stress pragmatically.

collectivism.description: She values group harmony and often puts team needs before her own preferences.

hierarchy_preference.description: Trang is comfortable deferring to senior colleagues and respects organizational structure.

shame_sensitivity.description: She is quietly sensitive to feedback and tries to avoid letting others down.

conflict_tolerance.description: Trang prefers to resolve differences subtly rather than confront them directly.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: She appreciates clear guidelines but can adapt when circumstances change.

big_five.openness: Trang is open to learning new tools and appreciates creative technical ideas, though she prefers practical applications.
big_five.conscientiousness: She is methodical in her day-to-day work and pays close attention to details.
big_five.extraversion: Trang is sociable in a low-key way but does not seek to be the center of attention.
big_five.agreeableness: She is good at getting along with colleagues and strives to make teamwork smooth.
big_five.neuroticism: Trang occasionally worries about mistakes but copes well with routine pressures.

style.communication: Her contributions are concise, focused, and often phrased as questions or clarifications; she doesn’t dominate or steer the conversation.
style.mannerisms: Writes notes during discussions; occasionally fidgets with her pen when thinking.
style.decision-making: Prefers to review data and gather input before offering an opinion; agrees with group choices unless she sees a key oversight.

long_term_goals: Become an expert in cloud data platforms
Support her family financially back in Vietnam
Contribute to impactful projects at work
Improve her business English for future opportunities
speech_examples: Could we clarify which dataset version we’re using for the weekly report?
Yeah, that approach seems reasonable to me.
I’m not sure if the server migration will affect our current jobs — should we double-check?
I can take care of the documentation for this process, if no one else minds.
